title: Romantic Getaway to Peru: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Peru. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Peru sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Trypinn Team
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Peru. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Peru for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Peru
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Peru](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1632913582790-d0ec5882095a?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Couples spa treatments using local ingredients offer relaxation and rejuvenation in Peru.

## Where to Stay

Charming bed and breakfasts in Peru provide cozy accommodations with home-cooked breakfasts.
